at_sea: aider-builds-a-piece is PROVED and pushed (cairn 92c0e73, commons 0a04785). The shim stopped being inert: driver.drive_brief runs the real aider Coder inside the venv and returns serializable data (before/after file images, what aider reported edited, asks allowed, error), appended to ~/.cairn/devices/aider_shim/0/drives.jsonl. Six proofs green twice bare and sealed under netns; four mutants bite. Both watches armed: offload_yield_probe and the new edit_survival_probe (16 teeth). THE FALSIFIER IS HALF-MET AND THE OTHER HALF IS THE FINDING - the offload probe's population moved off zero for the first time (1 shimmed ticket, 8 verdicts, all pass), but no edit was ever applied: two live fires against qwen3-coder:30b on a 13,932-char brief both returned fenced python code blocks instead of SEARCH/REPLACE, edit_format pinned to 'diff', 1 allowed ask, 0 reflections, no hash moved. The survival watch's first real reading is 'not-applied'. Two hypotheses killed and now scars in driver.py: aider's ModelInfoManager dials raw.githubusercontent.com on a cold cache (a road the interceptor does not cover), and log_path=None built an in-memory SeenLog so every recorded ask died with the venv process.
